name: MonarchInstallVerify
title: InstallVerify
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column with MonarchCodeSnippetTabs (androidx.compose.material3.SecondaryScrollableTabRow over MonarchCodeBlock), MonarchCopyButton, MonarchButton, MonarchProgress and the system share sheet (android.content.Intent.ACTION_SEND through Intent.createChooser)
summary: Install a snippet on a website and wait for it to report: code per platform with copy, a handoff for a developer through the share sheet, then a status that turns from waiting to connected, with the expected sites and when each was last seen.
whenToUse: In onboarding or settings where a person must add a tag, script or plugin to their site and the product can tell when it loads.
whenNotToUse: For code examples with no verification, use MonarchCodeSnippetTabs. For DNS records, use MonarchDnsRecordTable with MonarchDomainProgress.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchInstallVerify(snippets: List<MonarchInstallSnippet>, status: MonarchInstallVerifyStatus, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, part: MonarchInstallVerifyPart = MonarchInstallVerifyPart.All, selection: String? = null, onSelectionChange: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, connectedOn: List<String>? = null, targets: List<MonarchInstallTarget> = emptyList(), now: Long? = null, developerInstructions: String? = null, testDisabled: Boolean = false, testHint: String? = null, labels: MonarchInstallVerifyLabels = MonarchInstallVerifyLabels(), onShareInstructions: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onOpenTest: (() -> Unit)? = null, onConnected: (() -> Unit)? = null, credential: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
data class MonarchInstallSnippet(id: String, label: String, code: String, language: String? = null, description: String? = null)
data class MonarchInstallTarget(label: String, lastSeenAt: Long? = null, id: String? = null)
enum class MonarchInstallVerifyStatus { Waiting, Connected, Unavailable }
enum class MonarchInstallVerifyPart { All, Install, Verify }

class MonarchInstallVerifyLabels(installHeading: String? = null, verifyHeading: String? = null, platforms: String? = null, copyInstructions: String? = null, instructionsCopied: String? = null, shareInstructions: String? = null, waitingTitle: String? = null, waitingBody: ((targets: List<String>) -> String)? = null, connectedTitle: ((hosts: List<String>) -> String)? = null, connectedBody: String? = null, unavailableTitle: String? = null, unavailableBody: String? = null, targetsLabel: String? = null, seen: ((time: String) -> String)? = null, notSeen: String? = null, openTest: String? = null)

options.name: snippets
options.description: The install options, one tab each; a single snippet shows without tabs. The shown snippet's description is above its code.

options.name: status
options.description: Waiting for the first report, Connected once seen, or Unavailable when the product cannot check.

options.name: part
options.description: Both halves under Install and Verify headings, or one half without heading for a wizard step.

options.name: selection
options.description: The id of the snippet shown. The component keeps the person's choice and starts again from this value when it changes.

options.name: onSelectionChange
options.description: Called with the id of the snippet the person picks.

options.name: connectedOn
options.description: The hosts for the connected title. Null uses the targets that have a lastSeenAt.

options.name: targets
options.description: The sites the install is expected on, listed with when each was last seen.

options.name: now
options.description: The time last seen is measured from, in epoch milliseconds. Null reads the clock once.

options.name: developerInstructions
options.description: A plain-text handoff for a developer. Shows Copy instructions for your developer and Share with your developer.

options.name: testDisabled
options.description: Disables Open a test page; say why in testHint.

options.name: testHint
options.description: One line under the test page button.

options.name: onShareInstructions
options.description: Shares the handoff instead of the system share sheet.

options.name: onOpenTest
options.description: Shows Open a test page; the app opens the page, for example with a browser intent.

options.name: onConnected
options.description: Called once, the first time status is Connected while the component is shown.

options.name: credential
options.description: Content above the snippets: the key the snippet needs and its state (creating, ready, failed with a retry).

states.name: waiting
states.description: A small spinning indicator with Waiting for your site… and the sites to open; the box uses the subtle background.

states.name: connected
states.description: A success dot with Connected on and the hosts; the box uses the success subtle fill and border.

states.name: unavailable
states.description: An info dot with Live verification isn't available and what to check by hand; the box uses the info subtle fill and border.

states.name: site seen and not seen
states.description: Each site has a success dot and seen 5 minutes ago, or a strong-border dot and not seen yet.

states.name: test page disabled
states.description: The button is disabled and the hint says why.

appearance: Headings in the subheading style. Snippets use MonarchCodeSnippetTabs. The status box has the large radius with subtle, success subtle or info subtle fills and matching borders, a strong body title and muted body text. Sites are body text with muted caption times. The same roles adapt to dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web shows the code in a multi-line CopyField and links for the email handoff and the test page. On Android the code is MonarchCodeSnippetTabs (with its own copy button), the developer handoff opens the system share sheet, as the plan asks, beside a copy button, and the test page is a callback, because components do not navigate. The web's mailto link is covered by the share sheet. Times are epoch milliseconds and last seen uses DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString in the device language. The web's heading level is not offered. The waiting indicator is MonarchProgress, which stands still when animations are off. iOS has no entry for this id yet. Experimental: a product pattern until a Rook app adopts it.
accessibility: Install and Verify are headings when both halves are shown.
The snippet tabs are Material 3 tabs named Platform, with the selected state.
The status is one element in a polite live region, so a change from waiting to connected is announced; its indicator is hidden.
The sites are a group named Websites, one element per site read as its name and when it was last seen; the dots are hidden and the state is in words.
Copy, Share and Open a test page are buttons with 48dp touch targets; the disabled test button is not enabled for TalkBack.
Status and site text wrap at the largest font scale.
edgeCases: No snippets: the install half shows only the credential and the handoff.
A selection no snippet has shows the first snippet.
Connected without connectedOn or seen sites reads Connected.
onConnected fires once per time the component is in the composition, even if the status flips back and forth.
When no app can share text the share button does nothing; the copy button still works.

examples.title: Install and verify
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space4)) {
    @OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
    MonarchInstallVerify(
        snippets = listOf(
            MonarchInstallSnippet(id = {{snippets.0.id}}, label = {{snippets.0.label}}, code = {{snippets.0.code}}, description = {{snippets.0.description}}),
            MonarchInstallSnippet(id = {{snippets.1.id}}, label = {{snippets.1.label}}, code = {{snippets.1.code}}, description = {{snippets.1.description}}),
            MonarchInstallSnippet(id = {{snippets.2.id}}, label = {{snippets.2.label}}, code = {{snippets.2.code}}, description = {{snippets.2.description}}),
        ),
        status = if (connected) MonarchInstallVerifyStatus.Connected else MonarchInstallVerifyStatus.Waiting,
        targets = listOf(
            MonarchInstallTarget(
                label = {{target.label}},
                lastSeenAt = if (connected) {{target.lastSeenAt|millis}} else null,
            ),
        ),
        now = {{now|millis}},
        developerInstructions = {{developerInstructions}},
        testHint = {{testHint}},
        labels = MonarchInstallVerifyLabels(shareInstructions = "Email them"),
        onOpenTest = { /* Open {{testHref|raw}} in a browser. */ },
        credential = { MonarchInlineNotice(message = {{credential}}, tone = MonarchTone.Success) },
    )
    MonarchButton(
        text = if (connected) {{reset}} else {{simulate}},
        onClick = { connected = !connected },
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary,
        size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm,
    )
}
examples.code:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space4)) {
    @OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
    MonarchInstallVerify(
        snippets = listOf(
            MonarchInstallSnippet(id = "html", label = "HTML", code = "<script src=\"https://cdn.example.com/widget.js\" data-key=\"pk_test_4f1a9c\" async></script>", description = "Paste it before the closing </body> tag on every page."),
            MonarchInstallSnippet(id = "react", label = "React", code = "import { Widget } from 'example-widget';\n\nexport function App() {\n  return <Widget publishableKey=\"pk_test_4f1a9c\" />;\n}", description = "Render it once, near the root of your app."),
            MonarchInstallSnippet(id = "npm", label = "npm", code = "npm install example-widget", description = "Install the package, then use the React snippet."),
        ),
        status = if (connected) MonarchInstallVerifyStatus.Connected else MonarchInstallVerifyStatus.Waiting,
        targets = listOf(
            MonarchInstallTarget(
                label = "www.example.com",
                lastSeenAt = if (connected) 1_768_046_340_000L else null,
            ),
        ),
        now = 1_768_046_400_000L,
        developerInstructions = "Add this snippet to every page of www.example.com: <script src=…>",
        testHint = "A page running the real widget, so you can try it yourself.",
        labels = MonarchInstallVerifyLabels(shareInstructions = "Email them"),
        onOpenTest = { /* Open https://example.com/try in a browser. */ },
        credential = { MonarchInlineNotice(message = "Publishable key ready. It only works on your listed websites.", tone = MonarchTone.Success) },
    )
    MonarchButton(
        text = if (connected) "Reset demo" else "Simulate the site reporting in",
        onClick = { connected = !connected },
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary,
        size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm,
    )
}

parityExceptions.reason: The web label of this button joins its visible text and hidden text with no separator; on Android the button is named with a sentence for TalkBack and its visible text is shown as it is.
parityExceptions.convention: a control is named in a sentence, not by concatenated visible text (Material accessibility)
paths: Copy instructions for your developerInstructions copied
